faqs.question: Will this motherboard fit my laptop?
faqs.answer: This board is for the HP ProBook 430 G4 and 440 G4 with a Core i5 7th generation processor. Motherboards differ between models and processor versions, so send us your laptop model, or a photo of the sticker under the laptop, on WhatsApp and we'll confirm before you order.

faqs.question: How do I know my motherboard is faulty?
faqs.answer: A laptop that won't power on, shows no display, restarts by itself or no longer charges may have a faulty motherboard, but the fault can also be the charger, battery, RAM or screen. Send us the symptoms on WhatsApp and we'll help you check before you buy.

faqs.question: Can I fit this myself?
faqs.answer: The laptop has to be taken apart to reach the board, so most customers have it fitted by us. Tell us your model on WhatsApp and we'll say what the job involves.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with this motherboard?
faqs.answer: This motherboard comes with a warranty — message us on WhatsApp for the current term before ordering.
